name: com.gtmotto/gtmotto
title: GTM Otto
description: Self-driving LinkedIn prospecting from Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT. Describe who you want to meet; GTM Otto finds them daily, warms them up from your own LinkedIn account, invites them and opens the conversation. Nothing is said without you.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. `Bearer gtm_sk_...` with an API key minted at https://app.gtmotto.com/connect. When the header is absent the server uses OAuth: the client shows a Connect card on the first protected call and the user signs in in the browser.
